purpose: Fail-closed contract for safely promoting verified pending candidates into jobs-data.json without losing existing LIVE jobs or user-facing compatibility.
preconditions: candidate.locationEligibility must be ba-area or remote-ok
candidate must have stable id, canonical url, source, sourceType, sourceTrust, scoreConfidence, verifiedAt and locationReason
remote-ok must contain explicit Slovakia-compatible remote evidence; unclear distant hybrid remains unknown/rejected
candidate id and canonical role identity must not duplicate an existing LIVE job

afterTransform: existing stable-id set is a subset of resulting stable-id set
job count may only increase by intended promotions
no existing job fields changed unless explicitly part of the promotion
all promoted jobs pass location hard gate

expectedBenefit: Removes the current write-side bottleneck safely: verified BA/remote candidates can move from pending to LIVE without risking loss of the existing feed.
